title: Starship Update
summary: SpaceX's September 2019 Starship update presentation, where Elon Musk describes the design and development of Starship and Super Heavy. It covers construction and plans for reusable orbital rockets.
why: HN uses it as the primary source for what Musk actually said, such as making fuel from atmospheric CO2.
